Hagane - Briefing Room
Lieutenant Irm.@I'm sorry to bother you at a time like this,@but there's something I'd like to ask.
You don't have to force the polite talk with me.@It's scarier when people get all formal.@Makes me wonder what they're hiding.
...That's quite a thing to say.
Yeah, that's just about right.
Same goes for me, Lieutenant Calvina.
Roger.
So, what did you want to ask?
Field commission or not, I'm a member@of the <Steel Dragons> now... So, about@how things are in the unit, and our mission.
Right. Before we met you on the moon, our mission@was a shakedown cruise under the new organization.
New organization?
After the last war... <The Sealing War>, the Steel@Dragons moved from the Far East Command to the Joint@Chiefs of Staff. We got a new commander and captain.
That'd be Brigadier General Miles Boothroyd and@Colonel Ginto Kitaumi. From a regional post to HQ...@That's a promotion for you people, isn't it?
Thing is, it's not really like that.
Then I suppose the new commander and captain@are beast tamers with thorny whips.
That's a good way to put it.@Well, Commander Miles keeps us on a tight leash.
He's a real nitpicker, seriously.
I can't deny it feels more restrictive than before,@but it doesn't bother me. This is the military.
Well, sure, that's fine for you, since you joined@the military through the proper route.@But Aya, Mai and I were scouted as civilians.
Tenia
Huh, really?
Yeah. When I was in high school,@they saw my skill at <Burning PT>@and brought me into the SRX Team.
For Mai and me, it was because our father was@involved in the <SRX Project>, a development@project for robot weapons.
Huh.
...And what about the Steel Dragons'@former commander and the Hagane's former captain?
The former commander, Lieutenant Colonel Lefina@Enfield, now serves solely as captain of the@multipurpose battle carrier Hiryu Custom...
And Major Tetsuya Onodera, who was the Hagane's@captain, is now the executive officer.
So, a demotion. Taking the blame for That Incident?
Pretty much.
What incident?
Former President Glassman's fatal accident.@During <The Sealing War>, his plane collided with the@Hagane. People argued whether it was deliberate.
I don't really get it...
Truth is, it was a grand assassination plot set up@by the Special Vice President, who was an alien...@but to save face, they reorganized and cracked down.
Um... So, like, a strict teacher got sent@to a class full of problem kids?
We're the problem kids now?
That's not entirely wrong. We have many nonstandard@units that need lots of maintenance, and securing spare@parts and ammo for our many weapons costs a lot.
True... Our unit's a real money pit.
And now my Bellzelute's been added to that.@So, what's the Steel Dragons' current objective?
To go to <Cross Gate> Space@and join up with the watch fleet.
The Cross Gate...@I've heard that a few times since coming here.@You mean that big ring-shaped structure?
Yeah.
For something like that to happen...@It's not some big alien ship like the@Federation government announced, is it?
The government's official statement is a deception@to turn the public's eyes away from the truth.
Right... Originally, it was ruins under the Antarctic@ice. No one knows who built it, when, or why,@but it leads to another world.
The <Ruina>, who mainly attacked South America in@the Sealing War, came out of that Cross Gate.
I never knew...
After that, the Earth was covered by a dimensional@rift, and the <Black Sky> appeared.@Tenia, you know about that too, right?
Yeah... The town I lived in was in an uproar.
A lot happened, but we beat the Ruina...@We couldn't destroy the Cross Gate, though,@so it stayed in low orbit.
After the war, a Federation space fleet watched it,@and just as a full study was starting, that happened.@We're joining the watch fleet in case of the worst.
The worst...
You're saying the Ruina might come out again?
Them, or something close to them.@The Joint Chiefs probably want us@to stop it at the water's edge.
That shower of light... Isn't it too late already?
Even so, dealing with it is our job.
(Defenders of justice, in other words.@...Not that I am.)
Cross Gate Space
Steel Dragons
Hagane: Bridge
Tetsuya
Captain, beginning transfer to 350 km@low orbit via Hohmann orbit.
Mm.
Miles
What's the status of the <Cross Gate>? No change?
Eita
So it seems.
Commander, once we reach the <Cross Gate>'s altitude,@I'd like to deploy our mobile units. Is that all right?
Even though no enemies have been confirmed?@Then if something happens, we won't be able@to respond until we've recovered them.
I weighed that risk and judged@it a necessary measure.
That is not the best answer.
Then I withdraw it.
(The captain is very wary of the Cross Gate.@So am I, after seeing it firsthand in the Sealing@War. And yet the commander...)
No, wait.
I take back what I said.@Not if something happens. Something already has.@So there's no harm in being more cautious.
Captain, as you proposed, I authorize@the mobile units' sortie.
Sir!
Captain. All mobile units deployed.
Then we'll now approach the <Cross Gate>.@Both engines ahead standard. All-around alert.
Wow... Earth is so pretty.
Didn't you see it on the way up to space?
No... I was too excited to sleep the night before,@so I fell asleep once I got on the shuttle.
...I see.
(But... I wish I'd never gone to space.@If I'd known that would happen...)
Tenia, keep your eyes on the radar.
...I know.
(Whatever the situation,@if that gray one shows up, this time for sure...)
...! This feeling...
What is it, Ing?
I feel like someone's watching us.@It might just be my imagination.
No, I sense it too.@Something alien... like hostility...
So whatever it is, it's no friend of ours.
Can you really trust@something that vague?
We're the Federation Army's top <Telekinetic> unit.@Not that I'm one myself.
You're saying you sense enemies with telekinesis?@That makes no sense to me.
Amplifying thoughts with the <T-LINK System>@spreads a special sense, likened to a sixth sense@like touch, to pinpoint enemy locations.
So you're one too?
No, I only know about it.
I see. If you've got so many espers, I'd like you@to track down where those guys from before hide out.
(Jeez, she sure likes to pick fights.)
...Aya, can you sense anything?
Yes... Something seems to be@approaching from 2 o'clock.@Just... one.
2 o'clock... The direction of the Cross Gate.@All units, get ready to intercept.
Something's giving me the creeps. Bad feeling.
Yeah... It's getting stronger and stronger.
This is starting to sound like the occult.@I can't see anything yet.
But they're not lying.@I think I can feel it too...
So you're an esper too?@You've gotta be kidding.
This never happened before@I got in the Bellzelute...@Calvina, don't you feel anything?
Only that something's fishy, for a while now.@This telekinetic talk.
Visual on the approaching unknown!@Closing from 2 o'clock, 15 degrees below!
Put it on the main screen.
Wh... What is that?!
A-A monster?!
I've seen that thing before.
Ares Geist...!
What!?
That's right... It's got huge wings,@but that's the Ares Geist!
It's true...!
But the Ares Geist ended up getting@absorbed into the <Adamatron>, didn't it?!
It could be a different unit... a copy or an imitation.
With this timing, doesn't it make more@sense to think it came out of the@Cross Gate?
Then how did it come back?@We wiped out the Adamatron ourselves.
Hey, I'd like to know that myself.
Spiria 0 to Steel 2. Requesting instructions.
...Commander, your decision.
Hm, hmm... If the target came out of the Cross@Gate, I'd want instructions from the Joint Chiefs...@but there's no time to wait for an answer, is there?
It can't be helped. Issue a warning, Captain.
Understood. Issuing a warning to the target.
...Lieutenant Irm, what's going on?@I'm not following.
An enemy we thought we'd beaten came back as@a ghost. ...It's entering our range.
Is Duban Org aboard?
I don't know.@At least, I can't sense any human thoughts.
Azuki
The target is ignoring our warning!@No response!
It can't be helped. I authorize an attack!
Roger. Spiria 0 to all units, commence attack.
I've got no reason to fight something like that...!
Something's happening to the Ares Geist...!
Ah, it's running...?!
I-It's fast!
Target rapidly leaving the combat area!@It's descending to Earth!
Don't let it escape! Pursue it!
We can't send every unit into the atmosphere@at once. We'd have to pursue with this ship.@Is that acceptable?
Hm, hmm...
Please give your orders with that in mind.
I don't need to be told.@I'll seek the Joint Chiefs' judgment.@Stand by until then.
(What...?)
...Understood.@XO, bring back units that need resupply and repairs.
(Standing by, in this situation...?)
(I don't think it's just a look-alike.@If it came out of the Cross Gate,@like Ryusei said...)
(How on earth was it revived?)
(Is it the Ares Geist we fought, restored?@Or something else, copied@by some means...?)
(And why did it attack us?)
(Like I did That Time...@Did the Ares Geist break away@from the Adamatron too...?!)
No idea how it came back...@but for a revived monster, it got way too@much of a power-up in the looks department.
(Are you saying the Ares Geist wasn't destroyed@in the Sealing War's final battle, but drifted@on the far side of the Cross Gate...?)
(Whether that Ares Geist is real or fake,@it did come out of the Cross Gate,@didn't it...?)
It's just like the <Einst>.@I don't know what's going on, but I'm not@letting some unknown thing like that beat me.
Daniel
If the unknown is the same being as the Ares@Geist, this is grave. Something destroyed in the@last war has returned.
Sir... How shall we respond?
We're considering it now.@Until we reach a conclusion, the Hagane will carry@out patrol duty near the Cross Gate.
Understood.
Also, after entering low orbit, the unknown@apparently changed its descent trajectory,@and ground observation lost track of it too.
So it went into hiding somewhere on purpose...
Exactly.@Several other unknowns also descended to Earth@at the same time as the Cross Gate's light burst.
So that's what happened...
Depending on the situation, we may have you@descend to Earth, so be prepared.
That is all, then.
Captain, you heard him.@Prepare for descent to Earth while@we rendezvous with the Cross Gate Watch Fleet.
Roger.
Hagane - Hangar
Can't believe we ran into the Ares Geist.
Yeah...
We can't say for sure that's what it was yet.@It could be a copy, or a dead copy.
It's bigger and it's got wings,@so I don't think it's a dead copy.@If anything, it's reverting to its roots.
Even so, it's still@a counterfeit of the <Einst>.
Either way, shouldn't we tell@Lieutenant Arieil Org?
Yeah... Depending on how things go,@we might end up having to wake her.
...Hey, what is this Ares Geist?
Before I explain that...@Have you heard of the <Gaia Savers>?
The President's own unit, separate from the Federation@Army, right? They bragged about repelling a <Zovorg>@force that tried to take Paris.
Right. The Ares Geist is the commander unit@of one of the Gaia Savers' squads,@Beta Saber.
That? That monster?
Back in <The Sealing War>,@it looked a bit cleaner than that.
It still looks like the <Einst> to me.
Actually, there is a connection.@The Ares Geist's generator,@the Fau Kern...
repurposes the core of the Jetzt Regisseur,@which you could call a dead copy of a large Einst.
That's insane.
Well, the Gaia Savers themselves were like that.@A lot of their members and the mobile weapons@they used had shady origins.
Come to think of it, I heard the Gaia Savers ended@up fighting the Federation Army and got wiped out.
Yes... The Steel Dragons detachment I was with@took part in the final battle against them.
The Gaia Savers' real leader,@Arteul Steinbeck, wasn't from Earth.@He was from <Balmar>...
His goal was to claim the Cross Gate@found in Antarctica for himself.
To that end, he fused the technology the Gaia@Savers had gathered and created a huge mobile@weapon called the <Adamatron>.
And the Ares Geist had been@absorbed into it.
And you people beat@this Adamatron thing?
Yes, inside the Cross Gate... in the boundary space.
So an enemy you thought you'd beaten@came back from the underworld.
Th-Then the other side of the Cross Gate@is the afterlife?!
No, it's not like that.@Though the laws of our world don't apply there...
...Was the Ares Geist a manned unit?
Yes, Duban Org of the Gaia Savers@piloted it.
Org?@Didn't someone with the same family name@come up just now?
You mean Lieutenant Arieil Org.
That's right.
Arieil and Duban were Idealand... Put simply,@test subjects for artificial humans with superior@abilities. The two are like brother and sister.
Artificial humans...?
That said, they're not machine-based@like my prosthetic arm.
You mean biological?@I've heard rumors about that sort of thing...@So they really exist.
...There's one right in front of you, Lieutenant.
No way... You too?
That's right, but I'm an artificial human@of a different category from the Idealand.
(He looks like a normal boy, though...)
You say that so casually.@Don't you ever question your own existence?
I used to... But thanks to everyone@in the Steel Dragons,@I can be here like this.
What lovely camaraderie. Telekinetics,@artificial humans... What else have you got?
A cat that speaks human language, I guess.
Huh, what's that?! I wanna see!
Ah, he's not here right now.
Oh... Too bad.
So... Lieutenant Arieil Org seems to be@one of your own now?
Yeah, she realized what the Gaia Savers really were,@deserted, and joined the Steel Dragons.
After that, Lieutenant Arieil fought@Duban's Ares Geist alongside us.
So is he still in it now?
Captain Aya said she couldn't sense any@human thoughts from that Ares Geist.
So it's unmanned...@Or maybe, true to the name Geist,@there's a ghost aboard.
(If the Ares Geist has been revived, then the@Adamatron that absorbed it... That man, too?)
(No, that can't be...@<Euzeth> should have been destroyed That Time...)
